highlights.excerpt: I've never known the tech world to be more unanimous about anything than they are about Jensen Huang. Everyone in tech thinks the board made a huge mistake. Except the board. But they are not in tech.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我从未见过科技圈对任何事都像对黄仁勋这样意见一致。科技界人人都认为董事会犯了大错。除了董事会自己。但他们并不属于科技圈。
highlights.name: Paul Graham
highlights.text_zh: 称科技圈对黄仁勋空前一致：几乎人人都认为NVIDIA董事会犯了大错。

highlights.excerpt: It is amazing that human language turned out to be so unreasonably effective at modeling the universe that training a system to predict what comes next in a sentence would get us this far.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 令人惊叹的是，人类语言对宇宙的建模竟如此「不合理地有效」，以至于训练一个系统去预测句子里的下一个词，就能走这么远。
highlights.name: Ethan Mollick
highlights.text_zh: 感叹人类语言对宇宙建模「不合理地有效」，下一词预测就能走到今天这一步。

highlights.excerpt: It’s been a while since I felt a model was intelligent and fast at the same time and is too good to be true. Gemini Neon (Reasoning set to High) is that. Enjoying using it on Perplexity Computer. I’ve migrated some of my Teammates to this model as well. Congrats to
highlights.excerpt_zh: 已经有一段时间，我没有觉得某个模型既聪明又快、好到不像真的。Gemini Neon（推理设为 High）就是这样。我在 Perplexity Computer 上用得很开心。我也把一些同事迁到了这个模型上。恭喜
highlights.name: Aravind Srinivas
highlights.text_zh: 称赞 Gemini Neon（High 推理）又快又聪明，已在 Perplexity 使用并迁入同事。

highlights.excerpt:
all our agents at langchain (internal GTM & content agents, LangSmith Engine) have a learning loop with similar pieces

wrote about what we think makes up a "knowledge factory"
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我们在 LangChain 的所有智能体（内部 GTM 与内容智能体、LangSmith Engine）都有结构相近的学习闭环。

我写了我们认为「知识工厂」由哪些部分组成
highlights.name: Harrison Chase
highlights.text_zh: 称 LangChain 内部智能体都有学习闭环，并撰文解释「知识工厂」的构成。

highlights.excerpt: More likely than permanent underclass is we will all be permanent middle class
highlights.excerpt_zh: 比起出现永久底层，更可能的是我们都会变成永久的中产。
highlights.name: levelsio
highlights.text_zh: 认为 AI 时代更可能让所有人都变成「永久中产」，而非永久底层。

highlights.excerpt:
we very clearly live in a new world now, and less than 0.001% of the human population understands this.

the tech tree is about to open up:
a) in ways that sound science fiction to most
b) much sooner than they believe to be possible

2027-2030 will be a shock to the world.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我们显然已经活在一个新世界里，但理解这一点的人还不到人类的 0.001%。

科技树即将打开：
a) 以多数人听来像科幻的方式
b) 比他们以为的可能要快得多

2027–2030 年将给世界带来冲击。
highlights.name: Mckay Wrigley
highlights.text_zh: 称不足 0.001% 的人理解新世界到来，科技树将在 2027–2030 年让世界震惊。

highlights.excerpt:
卧槽！如果你想用 AI 做小游戏，却不知道这个 Skill，那真的有点白瞎了！

GitHub 上发现一个快 1 万 Star 的游戏开发技能库，直接给 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 编程工具装上 79 个专业游戏开发 Skills！

最离谱的是，它支持 12 种游戏引擎！

Godot、Unity、Unreal、Roblox、Three.js、Phaser
highlights.name: govin.eth | G哥
highlights.text_zh: 发现近 1 万星游戏开发 Skill 库，可为 Codex 与 Claude Code 装 79 个技能。

highlights.excerpt: As AI systems get more powerful, we believe we will see a speedup in the rate of scientific progress. How we prepare for this, build the infra to support it, and deal with the associated safety issues will define 2027 and beyond.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 随着 AI 系统变得更强大，我们相信科学进步的速度将会加快。如何为此做准备、建设支撑它的基础设施，以及应对相关的安全问题，将定义 2027 年及以后。
highlights.name: Jack Clark
highlights.text_zh: 认为更强 AI 将加快科学进步，如何建设基础设施并应对安全问题将定义 2027 年后。
